text.description_html:
Acorn IBKBP, Florence Toilet Paper Holder

The Florence Bath Tissue Holder was designed with the old world in mind, bringing a little bit of that hometown quaintness that so many houses are missing these days. The craftsmanship is stunning, as with all Acorn Hardware products. This toilet paper holder comes packages with the necessary mounting hardware.

Features and Specifications of the Florence Toilet Paper Roll Holder:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 8"
  • Height: 3-1/4"
  • Overall Projection: 3-3/4"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 toilet tissue holder and all necessary mounting screws.
